Class NativeGpio

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeGpio
All Implemented Interfaces:
Gpio
public final class NativeGpio extends Object implements Gpio
The board's Gpio: each method is a GPIO intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino core call, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock Gpio instead.
